newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf says 96 consolidated income climbs.
newsitem.headline: Elf says 96 consolidated income climbs.

text.p: Elf Acquitaine said in a statement on Thursday that estimated consolidated net income before special items for 1996 would be between 7.3 billion and 7.5 billion francs.
Net earnings per share would be 27 or 28 francs.
For 1995, consolidated net income before special items was 5.3 billion francs or 20 francs per share. "The board expressed satisfaction with this increase of around 40 percent," it said.
Elf said in the statement that its board of directors held a meeting on Wednesday to review the results.

It said the board had been informed about the conditions under which Fingestval, an indirect subsidiary of Elf Aquitaine, acquired 12.3 million shares of Elf or 4.5 percent of its capital. It noted this subsidiary's commitment to retain these shares for the long term. As a result, there will be 259.5 million shares in circulation at December 31, 1996, it said.
